# Native MILES and SGLang options

<!-- Generated by python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs; edit reference-help.json or source definitions. -->

For normal runs start with the [configuration guide](configuration.md). Native flags use underscores under [miles]. This appendix includes every pinned parser action, including aliases and inherited backend options. It does not claim every parser option is implemented by the Core trainer.

- [MILES options](native-training-options.md): 979 actions.
- [SGLang options](native-serving-options.md): 486 actions.

Help and raw defaults were captured from the actual parser in immutable Docker image `sha256:c30240ddb2793efc681a85f6104ba4e08b7721de14e93e59321e9c7db1412ea0`. The capture verified all action definitions against options.json; schema SHA-256: `6f63c766cfbfc285eaff852fb4f20ad79980b5a44f8b81a33fef1b06724cb75f`. This certifies the parser snapshot, not the image as a recommended training release.

Refresh inside the matching pinned runtime, from a writable checkout:

```bash
python -m scripts.miles.capture_option_help --image IMMUTABLE_IMAGE_ID
python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs
python -m scripts.miles.generate_docs --check
```

The capture refuses a parser-schema mismatch. If the runtime changed, regenerate and review options.json first using scripts/miles/snapshot_options.py. Source help is preserved; options without source help have reviewed supplements in reference-help.json. Conditional backend restrictions remain authoritative in config.py, validation.py and the installed runtime.
